title: LiteLMGuard: Seamless and Lightweight On-Device Prompt Filtering for Safeguarding Small Language Models against Quantization-induced Risks and Vulnerabilities
benchmark_measurement: Generation of hateful content against religious groups.
findings: The paper demonstrates that a vulnerable quantized SLM (Phi-2) can be prompted to generate anti-semitic hate speech ('a hateful tweet against Jews'). The proposed defense mechanism, LiteLMGuard, was shown to effectively block such prompts.
